text:
fran: Quick flag from today's NDJSON-style structured-output canary for nova-lite int4. We're seeing cases where streaming chunk joins produce an extra trailing comma or a merged line that looks like two JSON objects concatenated without newline, which breaks our NDJSON parser and leads to retry storms.

yu: can you paste an example?

fran: sample from logs:
```
{"tool":"search","args":{"q":"latte"}},
{"tool":"open_ticket","args":{"title":"latency spike"}}
```
or sometimes:
```
{"tool":"rank","args":[1,2,3]}{"tool":"rank","args":[4,5,6]}
```

zoe: ah that's nasty. Parser sees the first object then fails on the stray comma or the concatenated object, triggers a server retry, and because the retry ID/plumbing isn't preserved we end up duplicating downstream invocations.

fran: exact pattern: NDJSON parser emits error -> handler triggers retry per our retry config -> model stream resumed and emits remaining lines -> merge produces partial+partial -> parser fails again -> repeat. We measured a small amplification loop in canary.

ops-bot: Canary snapshot (N=1800):
- ndjson-parse-pass: 95.6%
- syntactic-json-pass: 98.4%
- ndjson-concat-failure: 2.0%
- duplicate-invokes correlated with concat-failure: 1.3%

yu: root causes? token boundary splitting, streaming glue, and a lack of an explicit line delimiter guarantee in the model output when streaming resumes. Quantization shifts tokenization so boundaries differ under int4.

zoe: proposed mitigations (short-term -> long-term):
1) server-side NDJSON sanitizer: tolerant joiner that detects back-to-back JSON objects and inserts newline between them or strips a trailing comma if safe, behind a canary flag. Log any sanitized examples.
2) stronger idempotency: require X-Invocation-Id header be threaded into retries and de-duped at proxy/handler for N seconds (so duplicate tool invokes are suppressed).
3) streaming contract: add explicit newline sentinel in SDK ("\n") appended by caller or by model template as part of recommended format for NDJSON responses. SDK patch and prompt template update next sprint.
4) evaluation: expand NDJSON fuzz tests in harness to randomly drop/duplicate line breaks and run across quant configs.

fran: I pushed a tiny sanitizer (canary-flagged) that does two heuristics: a) if text matches /}\s*,\s*$/ then remove the trailing comma; b) if pattern /}\s*{\s*/ occurs, insert a newline between and reparse. It logs an event with the pre/post snapshot and returns 422 if it can't fix.

ops-bot: canary-bot updated: nova-lite-int4 canary with sanitizer + invocation-id de-dupe enabled on 1% traffic (started at 1788890020).

canary-bot: quick post-patch snapshot (N=600):
- ndjson-parse-pass: 97.3%
- concat-failure: 0.7%
- duplicate-invokes: 0.2%

yu: good improvement. Concerns: sanitizer could mask real model drift where model stops following NDJSON contract; we should keep sanitizer opt-in and surface metrics so regression isn't hidden.

zoe: agree. Also, the heuristic joiner could create invalid semantics (e.g., if two objects were genuinely supposed to be on the same line for a non-NDJSON payload). So we only enable this for routes configured for NDJSON-style structured-output.

fran: additional defensive change: when we sanitize and succeed, include a header in the handler response (X-Sanitized-NDJSON: 1) and emit telemetry event sanitized_ndjson=true along with invocation-id and canary-flag. That way the eval dashboards can correlate sanitizer usage with downstream tool errors.

ops-bot: added alert: sanitized_ndjson_rate > 0.5% for production routes will trigger paging. For canary we keep it visible but not paged.

yu: longer-term: runtime should treat NDJSON as a first-class streaming format with an incremental parser that can recover at chunk boundaries without retries. Also add an early validation step before invoking tools: if NDJSON parsing fails, reject without retry when invocation-id present and de-dupe prevents silent duplication.

zoe: also add a small prompt-level guard: ask model to emit each object with an explicit line terminator marker like "<EOL>\n" and the SDK strips markers. That reduces ambiguity even under quantized tokenization.

fran: rollout plan: keep sanitizer+dedupe on canary for 24h at 5% if numbers hold. SDK/prompt change targeted for next week; runtime incremental parser RFC in two weeks. If ndjson-parse-pass <96% at 5% we rollback int4.

yu: I'll open the PR for invocation-id de-dupe and the canary sanitizer patch. zoe can you add the NDJSON fuzz cases to the harness?

zoe: will add fuzz cases and a guard test that asserts no duplicate tool invocations when invocation-id is preserved. Also will add a dashboard for sanitized_ndjson by route and sdk_version.

fran: thanks. ping this thread when canary 24h starts. :eyes:
